[Unit]
Description=Finalize Qisutu installation (__QISUTU_INSTANCE__)
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/systemctl enable --now __QISUTU_DAEMON_SERVICE__
ExecStart=/bin/systemctl disable --now __QISUTU_INSTALL_COMPLETE_PATH__
ExecStart=/bin/rm -f /etc/systemd/system/__QISUTU_INSTALL_COMPLETE_PATH__ /etc/systemd/system/__QISUTU_INSTALL_COMPLETE_SERVICE__
ExecStart=/bin/systemctl daemon-reload

[Unit]
Description=Watch for completed Qisutu web installation (__QISUTU_INSTANCE__)

[Path]
PathExists=__QISUTU_ROOT__/var/install/installed.lock
Unit=__QISUTU_INSTALL_COMPLETE_SERVICE__

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
Description=Qisutu Automation and Mail Daemon (__QISUTU_INSTANCE__)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=__QISUTU_RUNTIME_USER__
Group=__QISUTU_APACHE_GROUP__
WorkingDirectory=__QISUTU_ROOT__
Environment=QISUTU_HOME=__QISUTU_ROOT__
ExecStart=/usr/bin/perl __QISUTU_ROOT__/bin/qisutu-daemon.pl --sleep 3 --max-jobs 100
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStopSec=120
KillSignal=SIGTERM
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# Qisutu instance: __QISUTU_INSTANCE__
Alias __QISUTU_WEB_PATH__/static/ "__QISUTU_ROOT__/var/static/"

<Directory "__QISUTU_ROOT__/var/static/">
    Options -Indexes
    AllowOverride None
    Require all granted
</Directory>

ScriptAlias __QISUTU_WEB_PATH__/ "__QISUTU_ROOT__/bin/cgi-bin/"

<Directory "__QISUTU_ROOT__/bin/cgi-bin/">
    Options +ExecCGI -Indexes
    AllowOverride None
    AddHandler cgi-script .pl
    DirectoryIndex index.pl
    CGIPassAuth On
    Require all granted
    SetEnv QISUTU_HOME __QISUTU_ROOT__
</Directory>

RedirectMatch 301 ^__QISUTU_WEB_PATH__$ __QISUTU_WEB_PATH__/
